parties.respondent: Indian Navy Civilian Design Officers Association and Anr.

summary: Pay scale parity between Junior Design Officers (JDOs) and Civilian Technical Officers (CTOs); differing recruitment rules, qualifications, duties, and responsibilities; Fifth Central Pay Commission's recommendations binding; judicial non-interference in expert pay fixation unless grave error shown; Tribunal and High Court erred in equating posts; pay scale of Rs.7450-11500 for JDOs upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: State of U.P. and Others Vs. J.P. Chaurasia and Others, 1989(1) SCC 121
Union of India and Others Vs. Makhan Chandra Roy
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgments of High Court and Central Administrative Tribunal set aside; pay scale of Rs.7450-11500 for JDOs restored.
